title: answers stream summary record (v1)
description: The terminal record of a successful streamed answers run: the open exchange's observed metadata, the run's counts, and — exactly when a final usage event arrived — the observed usage at exact decimal scale. A stream that completed without usage omits the usage member and marks the cost unknown instead, so an unreported cost never reads as free.

deltas_emitted.$comment: The answer_delta records emitted before the terminal record.

usage.$comment: Present exactly when a final usage event arrived; never invented.

cost_unknown.$comment: True exactly when the stream ended without a final usage event: no cost figure may be assumed, and zero is a figure.
